method: Three independent fixed-pose datasets. New neutral portraits are structurally reviewed before expression edits. Full generated source images remain byte-identical; only registered eyes, mouths and eyebrows are composited at fixed native scale. Each actual multi-reference generation and refinement chain is preserved.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: neutral pose source portrait for an existing2DVTubercharacter.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep head facing straight toward viewer (yaw0, roll0), gently lift the chin approximately12–15degrees. This must be a real newly drawn frontal upward head angle: correct subtle underside of chin and nose, slightly foreshortened forehead, balanced eyes on the frontal face plane; not just moving features or looking up with eyeballs. Both open relaxed eyes look toward the viewer. Preserve image1's exact torso/shoulder/collar coordinates, neck base fixed (jacket collar top near y790, shirt neckline near y990), and naturally redraw upper neck connection. Keep lips comfortably below the nose with natural philtrum space, not crowded upward.
Preserve the approved character identity: same short tousled tomboy blue-gray hairstyle without ornaments, same softlyangular ovalface, palegreen/teal eyes, fine gray-violet tapered brows, small delicate low-saturation closed slight-smile mouth line. No thick lips, lipstick, lip shine, new clothing or accessories, no cat ears. Preserve illustration linework, brush shading, lavender-gray background, clothing and overall scale. Face should be natural and attractive, not a new person. Head-to-body scale remains exactly like image1, no zoom/crop/mirror, no shoulders/body movement. Return one 1122x1402 full portrait on original opaque background, no sheet, labels or text.
